key_difference: Both add the same inline isNumber() and toNumber() in the header, but (D) converts negative integers as -double(value64 + 1) with a hex-float -0x1p64 special case for the -2^64 wraparound, rounding only once, whereas (B) uses the simpler -double(value64) - 1 that mirrors toInteger(), and (D) calls the public toFloat16()/toFloat()/toDouble() accessors instead of _toFloatingPoint<T>() directly.
